# Gable Holdings

> Gable Holdings, LLC is a non-bank lender based in Palm Beach, Florida. Its account executives arrange residential and commercial real estate loans for investors, builders and brokers across multiple states. It is not a bank and does not take deposits.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Gable Holdings, LLC
- Address: 205 Worth Avenue, Suite 305, Palm Beach, FL 33480, United States
- Registration: Wyoming LLC, registered in Florida as a foreign LLC on October 6, 2015 (Florida document no. M15000007987); status active
- Manager: Weston E. Spicer
- Type: Non-bank lender (lending-related entity with account executives arranging multi-state lending)
- Lending: residential and commercial real estate, multiple states
- 24/7 AI lending desk in English, Spanish, Persian, German and Chinese; requests go to an account executive

## Loan programs
- Fix-and-flip: purchase and renovation, sized against after-repair value
- Bridge: short-term money while a property is sold or refinanced
- Ground-up construction: draw-based financing for new builds
- DSCR rental: long-term rental loans qualified on the property's rent
- Bank statement: for self-employed borrowers, qualified on deposits
- Commercial bridge: multifamily, mixed-use, retail, office and industrial
- Commercial permanent: longer-term financing for stabilized property

## How to start
Describe the deal to the lending desk at https://gable-holdings.vercel.app/#desk. It asks a few questions, checks the basics and sends the file to an account executive. All loans are subject to underwriting and approval; the desk never quotes or approves loans.

## Brokers
Brokers submit deals through the lending desk; partner brokers can add it to their own websites with one line of code, and leads are credited to them.
